dims_mm.note: Acer lists 299 x 127.4 x 28.5/58.37 mm. 58.37 mm is the depth at the grips.

weight_g.note: Acer: under 770 g with the 60 Wh battery. Arc G3 SKUs use the 60 Wh battery (Acer UK SKU table).

slots.note: One M.2 2280 PCIe Gen4 NVMe slot

ports.note: Acer: two Thunderbolt 4 ports for docking, display output and accessories
UHS-II, up to SD 4.0 (SD, SDHC, SDXC, SDUC)

screen.note: IPS-level, 16:10, 100% sRGB, Gorilla Glass Victus with DXC anti-reflection, 10-point touch. Matte 9H screen protector in the box.

battery.note: Acer UK SKU table: Arc G3 SKUs have the 60 Wh battery (Extreme SKUs have 80 Wh). 65 W USB-C adapter.

controls.stick_note: Full-size TMR sticks with RGB lighting (US product page and button diagram). Acer UK: "Every Atlas 8 is built with premium TMR" sticks. The May 2026 press spec table says carbon-film sticks; see conflicts.
controls.note: L/R adjustable trigger switches change between micro-switch mode and full-travel Hall analog mode. Rear L/R macro buttons. PredatorSense and Game Bar buttons.

cooling: dual fan (one metal Predator AeroBlade fan, one plastic fan)
notes: Base Arc G3 SKUs of the Predator Atlas 8. Acer UK prices: 16 GB / 512 GB / 60 Wh GBP 999.99; 24 GB / 512 GB / 60 Wh GBP 1,099.99 (PA08-I51-G9Q2 / NH.U7XEF.003, listed as Coming Soon on the Acer UK store on 2026-10-27). No US SKU or US price found. Chassis, ports, screen and controls are shared with acer-predator-atlas-8 (Arc G3 Extreme).
